topic: New music never sticks (discovery without adoption)
unmet_need: Reinforcement that converts a first play into a lasting habit
research_question: Q4 / core: adoption, not one-off plays
top_keywords: song; songs; play; music; sticks; new
example_quote: Dont have full control. You cant play the same song over and over again and your playlist will play songs that arent there

topic: No guided on-ramp into a new genre
unmet_need: Staged, goal-based exploration that coaches you into a genre
top_keywords: genre; new; spotify; way; new genre; actually
example_quote: Guided genre missions get into jazz over 3 weeks with a staged on-ramp would be a game changer for beginners.

topic: Stuck in a listening loop / same songs on repeat
unmet_need: Gentle nudges that expand the rotation without losing comfort
research_question: Q4 repeat-listening of the same content
top_keywords: songs; repeat; stuck; app; songs repeat; loop
example_quote: The same 50 songs on repeat problem is so real. I love them but I'm in a loop and the app does nothing to gently expand it.

unmet_need: A clear bridge explaining why a track fits your existing taste
top_keywords: like; song; trust; new; recommendations; recommendation
example_quote: Honestly when a recommendation explains why a track fits my taste, I trust it so much more. The 'why' is everything.

unmet_need: Genuinely novel recommendations that expand taste, not reinforce it
top_keywords: artists; discover; echo chamber; chamber; echo; weekly
example_quote: Same here. The algorithm keeps recommending the same five artists over and over. It feels like an echo chamber, not discovery.

unmet_need: A comfort-to-curiosity control over how far recommendations stretch
top_keywords: safe; want; days want; days; discovery; wish
example_quote: A comfort-to-curiosity dial is genius. The biggest gap in every recommender is control over how far the recs stretch.
